explanation: As the ambulance approaches, each new wave is launched closer to you than the one before, so the waves arrive more often — a higher frequency, which your ears hear as a higher pitch. This is the Doppler effect.

options.text: Higher — its sound waves are bunched closer together as it approaches
Lower — its sound waves are stretched out behind it
Exactly the same — a siren's pitch never changes for listeners
Silent until it is very close, then suddenly loud
